notes.title: All red + green cards implemented, on to automated testing
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone, just doing an update to let you all know I'm still alive and still working.

Largely I have been working on implementing card logic. There are now 97 cards that definitely function (some very complex), almost every card in the colors red and green. There will be more cards than this in these colors eventually, but I wanted some wiggle room to add cards for balance purposes. Next up is some more testing of those cards. Also adding the other colors.

Speaking of testing, I'm going to work on an automated testing system, where two decks are random constructed and then mouse clicks are simulated to simulate random games until something breaks. This should give me better test coverage than currently where I only manually play the game. I need to get it out to other people for testing purposes soon, but I need to get more placeholder art in there first. Honestly, maybe I'll just stream it playing by itself sometime, just for fun.[/p][p][/p][p]I also made a very 90s internet pack opening screen since Pygame finally supports GIFs. The amount of each card you get in a pack is customizable. The one thing I have not added to that screen is a fortune rare, which is not customizable. On some percentage of packs, you get a fortune rare, which is where you get to specify a list of cards you would want to get, and then use a paper fortune teller to determine which card you get. So basically, you can get a rare from a list you specify, to increase your odds of getting a specific card. I need to implement that system soon.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45152506/23579f19050ee602328e715d12a3de64193642c9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]I also did my first interview for the game with John Aljets, which I can apparently insert into this post. It went okay I think? I don't know, I refuse to look at or listen to myself.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="sKxiH2FkvmU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Also, I'll be going to Anime NYC with my mom. I'm getting POGS made to give out to people, with a QR code on the back taking people to Steam. People can only get a pog if they find me in person.[/p][p][/p][p]I'll probably make another update on here in a few months. Until then, feel free to reach out, I'm most accessible on [url="https://discord.gg/DenBbkpTwx"]Discord[/url] and [url="https://bsky.app/profile/eternalskiestcg.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url] (though other social media works too). Bluesky is also the best place to follow progress, as I post there every day.[/p][p][/p][p]Until next time,[/p][p]Connor[/p]

notes.title: We have a playable card game (with some cards)
notes.content:
Hello everyone, it's been a while since I updated things here on Steam. 

I just wanted to make a post to let people know that progress is, in fact, being made. I have worked on this project every single day since I started, and will continue to do so until it is finished. Plus now that my health issues are largely out of the way, I'm able to do things twice as fast as before.

I've made a lot of progress since the last time I posted here. There is a super retro [url=https://eternalskies.neocities.org/]website[/url] now, though some of it is a work in progress. The [url=https://eternalskies.neocities.org/rulebook]rulebook[/url] is up on there though. I have also made two crappy trailers featuring wordart [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hpEUg1lZk6w/]here[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uA8qf5E_VyE]here[/url] and a full game I played explaining the basic mechanics [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T4Tdy1BBzz0&t=1144s]here[/url].

Honestly, too much progress has been made and too much has changed to list it all here. The easiest way to see progress is to watch the basic gameplay video, since I just made it yesterday (the card gameplay and balance isn't good in that game though, it's just to explain and show the basic mechanics). The game is now largely playable against yourself for the two premade red and green decks, though I need to test it more. After I get back from my trip to Poland, I'll continue to clean up bugs but also probably make sure the rest of the cards in red and green are functional. Once those two colors are fully functional, I'll get some people other than me to try it out and help with balancing the cards.

Also I added a future feature of Arcade style modes. These will be styled like Mario Kart cups, and you will have to use the same deck throughout the entirety of the cup. It will hold leaderboards in a few different categories, like high score, fastest time, and fewest moves. 

Mostly these past few months have been filled with debugging and getting everything to be largely functional. Which it is! Largely. The biggest priority is getting the card gameplay engine to work as smoothly as possible, so I can have other card game veterans help me with balance while I move over to work on the RPG parts of the game. 

I'll probably make another update on here in a few months. Until then, feel free to reach out, I'm most accessible on [url=https://discord.gg/DenBbkpTwx]Discord[/url] and [url=https://bsky.app/profile/eternalskiestcg.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url] (though other social media works too). Bluesky is also the best place to follow progress, as I post there every day.

Until next time,
Connor

notes.title: Next Up: Explainer Videos, Card Logic, & Balancing the Card Game
notes.content:
Hello to whoever sees this, I don't really know how Steam announcements work. I figured I should probably give a short update as to what I'm working on.

First, I need to do a lot more explaining about the game. I'm going to make a couple YouTube videos, one that is a general overview of the game and one which is a deeper dive into the card game mechanics. I do have a rough draft of a rulebook that is available in the [url=https://discord.gg/DenBbkpTwx]Discord[/url], but it is very rough and will be changed a lot. 

The next goal is being able to play the card game against yourself, so I can start to balance the cards themselves and have other people try the game a little bit. The deck building screen is functional now. You can filter with OR or AND with left and right click, add and remove cards, save and load. This way decks can be built to playtest the game.

I'm currently working on implementing the game and card logic, as well as adding all the already made cards into the game. Once this is finished, I'll make it so you can play against yourself. After I play it a bit myself, I'll open it up to other people to help balance the card game. It will probably be wildly unbalanced from the get go, so everything is open for change, and I left myself plenty of room to still add more cards.

The card editor will not be functional yet at this point, but the cards can still be edited easily but just opening up the JSON files. So anyone who is testing out the game mechanics can just edit whatever they think should be changed and then see how their changes work out. 

Getting the actual card game functioning will be my primary focus for the next couple months. Once it's functional, I'll be looking for people who are big card game players to help me playtest and balance the cards in the game.

I'll probably make another update on here next time I hit a major break point, which is testing the card game mechanics. Until then, feel free to reach out, I'm most accessible on [url=https://discord.gg/DenBbkpTwx]Discord[/url] and [url=https://bsky.app/profile/eternalskiestcg.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url] (though other social media works too). 

Until next time,
Connor
